info.title: Trellis API
info.description: Social-network core API. Discovery surfaces, federation management (T3–T8), and entity/social graph endpoints.

oauth2.description: Third-party client access via the device authorization grant (RFC 8628): POST /oauth2/device_authorization, the user approves at /agents/authorize, the client polls POST /oauth2/token.

scopes.profile:read: Read your name, handle and avatar
scopes.entities:read: Read the profiles you can see
scopes.entities:write: Create and update profiles you own
scopes.tenant:read: Read which space you are in
